name: runheed
description: Your app reports errors; Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client reads the stack trace, fixes it and marks it resolved. Hosted remote server with OAuth. Paid, from $29/month with a 7-day trial.

examples.title: What broke in production today?
examples.description: List the newest errors and their counts.

examples.title: Look at the top error
examples.description: Read the stack trace for the most frequent error.
examples.prompt: _Show me the stack trace for the top error._

examples.title: Fix and resolve
examples.description: After a fix ships, mark the error resolved with the commit.
examples.prompt: _Fix it and resolve it with the commit hash._

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to Runheed (dynamic client registration, no key needed). Paid, from $29/month with a 7-day trial; a no-account demo server with sample errors is at https://runheed.com/api/mcp/demo.

tools.name: runheed_search_errors
tools.description: Searches the workspace's error groups by text (type, message, route, file or extra data), status, project and release (including only the errors a release introduced).

tools.name: runheed_get_error
tools.description: Returns one error group in full: message, status, counts, first and last seen, environment, agent context, the top stack frames and the latest breadcrumbs.

tools.name: runheed_get_recent
tools.description: Returns the error groups seen most recently, newest first, with status, type, message, route, top stack frame, event count, last-seen time and ID.

tools.name: runheed_get_trends
tools.description: Returns error statistics for the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days: total, new and resolved counts, the most frequent errors and the hourly error rate.

tools.name: runheed_get_error_context
tools.description: Returns everything recorded around an error: every breadcrumb, platform, runtime, OS, environment, release, the affected user, the agent session and extra data.

tools.name: runheed_resolve_error
tools.description: Marks one error group resolved (errorId), or up to 100 at once (errorIds) for duplicates fixed by the same change, with an optional note such as the fixing commit.

tools.name: runheed_ignore_error
tools.description: Marks one error group ignored (errorId), or up to 100 at once (errorIds), for known or expected errors such as browser noise, so new occurrences stop alerting.

tools.name: runheed_merge_errors
tools.description: Merges error groups that are the same bug into one: their events move to the target group (targetId) and new events with their fingerprints join it too.

tools.name: runheed_unignore_error
tools.description: Moves one ignored error group (errorId), or up to 100 (errorIds), back to unresolved, so new occurrences alert again.

tools.name: runheed_get_project_health
tools.description: Returns a 0 to 100 health score for a project (or the whole workspace), errors in the last 24 hours, the unresolved count, the error rate, recent issues and recommendations.

tools.name: runheed_list_projects
tools.description: Lists the workspace's projects with each project's ID, slug, platform and DSN (the value an app sets as RUNHEED_DSN to report errors).

tools.name: runheed_create_project
tools.description: Creates a project in the workspace and returns its DSN: the value an app sets as the RUNHEED_DSN environment variable so that runheed.init() reports its errors to this project.

tools.name: runheed_send_test_event
tools.description: Sends one test error (RunheedTestEvent) to a project through the normal ingest path, which shows whether the project and its send key work.
